# Algorithmic Art Gallery

> A web application for creating and exploring algorithmic art using space filling curves and mathematical patterns. Built by Jonathan R. Reed.

## About

Algorithmic Art Gallery is a free, browser-based tool for generating unique digital artwork. It uses space filling curves (Hilbert, Morton) and color mapping algorithms to create visually stunning patterns that are mathematically precise yet artistically beautiful.

Key features:
- Real-time pattern generation with customizable parameters
- Multiple curve types: Hilbert and Morton (Z-order)
- Various growth modes: Crystal, Nebula, Rings
- Symmetry options: None, Bilateral, Quadrantal, Radial
- Color progression controls: Sequential, Shuffled, Base Distance
- Export to PNG and PDF at up to 4096×4096 resolution
- Local gallery for saving favorite creations

## Pages

- [Generator](https://art.jonathanrreed.com/): Create new algorithmic art with customizable parameters
- [Gallery](https://art.jonathanrreed.com/gallery/): Browse and manage saved artworks
- [About](https://art.jonathanrreed.com/about/): Learn how the algorithms work and explore pattern options

## Technical Details

The application is built with:
- Astro (static site framework)
- React (interactive components)
- Web Workers (background processing for large patterns)
- Canvas API (rendering)
- Local Storage (gallery persistence)

Pattern generation uses:
- Hilbert Curve: Space-filling curve preserving locality for smooth color transitions
- Morton Curve: Z-order curve creating blocky, quadrant-based patterns
- Seed-based randomization for reproducible results
